working_definition: T5b is the OFF-motion direction-selective columnar neuron of the Drosophila optic lobe whose axon terminal projects to lobula plate layer b (layer 2), encoding motion in the diagonal back-to-front direction. Its dendrites arborise in lobula layer Lo1, distinguishing it from the ON-pathway T4b neuron whose dendrites are in medulla M10. Subtype identity within the T4/T5 combined transcriptomic cluster is defined by lobula plate layer targeting rather than a unique molecular marker.
searches_performed: OFF motion direction selective columnar neuron lobula

best_match.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: FBbt:00003738 'T5b neuron' is defined as the T5 subtype with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2, tuned to diagonal back-to-front motion — precisely matching the cluster definition. The cluster label 'T5b' is the canonical anatomical name used in FBbt. The FBbt term is the adult form (not immature), consistent with the adult-tissue atlas. The layer-2 axonal targeting and OFF-pathway columnar identity fully overlap with the report. Children T5bi (FBbt:00052247) and T5bii (FBbt:00052248) represent finer sub-subtypes based on sub-diagonal tuning not resolved at the transcriptomic level in this atlas, so the cluster maps correctly at the T5b level.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Pre- versus postsynaptic innervation judged by scoring of terminal morphology from figures in Fischbach and Dittrich (1989) as assessed by FlyBrain Neuron DB. The neurotransmitter was assessed with a split-GAL4 strategy using a Chat-DBD allele (FBal0198074) (Mauss et al., 2014) and single-cell transcript profiling (Shinomiya et al., 2014). Connectivity in the lobula was assessed by serial section electron microscopy of a single column (Shinomiya et al., 2014).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent class of T5b; too broad — does not capture the layer 2 / lobula plate specificity or directional identity of T5b. FBbt:00003738 is the appropriate exact-match subtype.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T5b neuron that responds to motion in a diagonal downward back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too specific — this is a sub-subtype of T5b based on sub-diagonal tuning not distinguished in the transcriptomic cluster.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T5b neuron that responds to motion in a diagonal upward back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too specific — same reason as T5bi; transcriptomic cluster maps at the T5b level.

recommendation: Accept FBbt:00003738 'T5b neuron' as an exact match. The FBbt term was found by direct label search, is non-obsolete, and its definition fully aligns with the cluster's anatomical identity (T5 subtype, lobula plate layer 2 arbor, OFF-motion, back-to-front direction tuning). No new term needed.
